_comment: Managed by chezmoi. Edit the SOURCE file ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_pi/agent/pi-packages.json, then run 'chezmoi apply' — edits to this target copy are overwritten.

run_pi-merge-settings.sh merges this fragment into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json on every apply: keys present here are synced from chezmoi and win; keys absent here stay machine-local (defaultModel, defaultProvider, defaultThinkingLevel, lastChangelogVersion are deliberately absent).
Installing a pi package ('pi install npm:@scope/pkg') only writes to this machine's settings.json and is REVERTED by the next apply unless its source string is also added to 'packages' below.
Keys starting with '_' are documentation-only and stripped before merging.
